historical_reviews.deepseek: Useful only for post-boot inventory; it cannot perform or verify the physical DIMM configuration and normal power-on.
historical_reviews.gpt_v2: Restores hardware setup/boot coverage and highlights the ambiguous phrase 'partial memory (2DPC)'.
historical_reviews.related_cases: Row427 is a fabric cable fault; row429 installs a privileged SSMD kernel module and stresses CPU.

original_test_intent: Verify that the platform boots normally with the exact approved partial 2DPC DIMM population and that firmware/OS inventory maps every installed module to the correct physical slot with no unexpected population or training errors.
original_method: Power down and discharge under ESD controls; record DIMM serial/part/capacity and socket-channel-slot plan; qualified operator installs the approved partial 2DPC matrix; inspect seating; cold boot with console/POST capture; collect SMBIOS Type 16/17/19/20, total memory and EDAC/RAS/SEL/dmesg evidence without clearing logs; reconcile every populated/empty slot and usable capacity; restore the reference population if required.
manual_activity: Qualified operator performs powered-down DIMM removal/installation and verifies labels/seating; engineer approves population rules and boot result.
required_inputs: Exact installed and empty slot list
Expected SMBIOS/usable total and error policy
safety_requirements: Full power removal/discharge and ESD handling
Preserve removed modules by labeled position
Stop on seating, smoke, POST loop or RAS failure
Do not clear logs or infer slot identity
agent_execution_scope: Capture console and post-boot software evidence

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: dmidecode/free are valid post-boot observations but omit the physical setup and POST acceptance.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: After the approved physical change and successful cold boot, capture `dmidecode -t 16 -t 17 -t 19 -t 20`, `free -b`, EDAC/RAS logs and SEL with exact tool versions.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: Partial 2DPC boot and per-slot memory correctness retained; latest-tool network download is replaced by a pinned approved artifact.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Use a signed population worksheet joining physical labels, firmware training, SMBIOS handles and OS usable capacity before and after the partial configuration.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds powered-down service controls, DIMM identity, full topology records, error evidence and restoration.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: An SSH inventory on the existing population cannot prove the required partial-2DPC power-on behavior.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: A wrong population can prevent POST or degrade channel mode; SMBIOS locator labels may differ from silk-screen names and require an authoritative map.

project_override_considerations: Owner defines whether 'partial 2DPC' means two DIMMs on selected channels, all channels at two DIMMs, or another supported reduced matrix, plus allowed capacity/reservation differences.
expected_evidence: Slot reconciliation and restored reference state

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: DeepSeek's commands are incomplete but compatible post-boot evidence; no reliable direct source identity contradiction was found.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Static review complete; execution gated by the meaning of partial 2DPC, exact slot map, operator, boot oracle and recovery.

engineering_decision_pending.question: Resolve Compatibility row428 Wistron-Memory-00001-V002: define the exact partial-2DPC installed/empty socket-channel-slot matrix, DIMM serial/PN/capacity map, supported population rule, cold-boot/training timeout, expected SMBIOS/usable capacity and RAS error policy, qualified ESD operator and reference restoration.

review_improvement: Separates physical configuration and boot training proof from the later read-only inventory check.
independent_technical_reasoning: The phrase 2DPC is a topology property, not a sufficient slot list. A passing result requires correlating the intended physical matrix to trained firmware resources, SMBIOS locators and OS-visible capacity; otherwise a missing or mislocated DIMM can be masked by a plausible total.
